sovereign_country.strategic_role: 苏伊士运河经济特区、辐射中东及北非的低成本轻工制造

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of Marine Outboard Engines and Compact Generators

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Civil Law with Islamic Sharia influences and administrative judicial review)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Egypt-USA Agreement on Bilateral Investment Treaty (1986)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Egyptian Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 (GAFI regulations); Executive Regulations of the Investment Law, particularly Chapter on Beneficial Ownership Disclosure; Egypt Anti-Money Laundering Law No. 80 of 2002 as amended by Law No. 36 of 2014 and implementing decisions of the Egyptian Money Laundering Combating Unit (EMLCU); Central Bank of Egypt Circular on Know-Your-Customer (KYC) requirements; Commercial Registry Law No. 34 of 1976 and its Executive Regulations.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of the foreign shareholder's Certificate of Incorporation and Good Standing certificate
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home country Registrar of Companies (e.g., UAE Ministry of Economy / DED for Dubai companies)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization by the Egyptian Consulate in the country of incorporation (Egypt is not a Party to the Hague Apostille Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized board resolution of the foreign corporate shareholder approving incorporation of the Egyptian LLC and appointing its initial representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate secretary / Notary Public in the home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization by the Egyptian Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copy of each ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) and each appointed manager/director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport issuing authority / Notary Public in the beneficial owner's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization for natural persons' official identity documents

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter (proving legitimacy of funding) issued for the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed commercial bank in the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization by the Egyptian Consulate or direct confirmation to the AML compliance officer of the authorized Egyptian bank

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence (EDD) screening of all UBOs, directors and senior managers against the Egyptian national terrorist entity list, OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, EU consolidated financial sanction list, and domestic PEP registers. Automated screening must be performed within 24 hours before incorporation submission; results must be documented and retained for at least 5 years under AML Law No. 80 of 2002 Article 9 (paras 1–4).

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: GAFI Electronic Company Registration and Name Reservation System (via gafi.gov.eg and the Commercial Registry of the Ministry of Trade and Industry)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All proposed company names must be submitted in Arabic script (standard Latin-script trade names permitted as an addendum, but the official registered name must be in Arabic). Transcription of foreign names must follow the Egyptian Ministry of Justice standard Arabic transliteration table. Names must not contain digits, symbols, or offensive terms unless explicitly approved by the GAFI Commercial Registry Authority.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection of the proposed name, the applicant shall submit a reasoned appeal in Arabic to the GAFI Commercial Registry Committee through the GAFI E-Service portal, attaching copies of relevant trade documents and an alternative equivalent transliteration if applicable. The Committee must render a decision within 10 working days; if the appeal is rejected, the applicant may file a second appeal before the GAFI Board of Directors within 15 days, whose decision is final for registration purposes but without prejudice to the right of recourse to the Administrative Court under Law No. 106 of 2013.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office addresses are not accepted for the LLC as a producing entity in industrial activity under ISIC 2811. GAFI and the Industrial Development Authority (IDA) require a registered physical address in Egypt, being either industrial land licensed for engine manufacturing or a commercial lease in a permitted industrial zone. A virtual PEP-only address may be disregarded for tax and customs recognition.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High (75% likelihood of an unannounced on-site inspection within the first 9 operating months) due to the industrial nature of diesel outboard engine manufacturing and the municipal compliance checks by the GAFI inspection department.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under Executive Regulations of Investment Law No. 72 of 2017

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial Registry registration of the LLC (incorporation filing)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Commercial Registry of the Ministry of Trade and Industry / GAFI one-stop shop
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under Commercial Registry Law No. 34 of 1976

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legalization and notarization of the foreign shareholder corporate documents at the Egyptian Consulate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Egyptian Ministry of Foreign Affairs / Egyptian Consulate in respective jurisdiction
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Consular service tariff (USD 50–100 per document, depending on jurisdiction)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Translation of foreign corporate documents into Arabic by a certified legal translator
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Accredited Legal Translator in Egypt (Ministry of Justice certified)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for certified legal translation per page (average 50–80 pages at approximately USD 3 per page plus fees)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of incorporation documents and mandate certificates in Cairo
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarization tariff as per Ministry of Justice schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: GAFI LLC incorporation fee (with non-resident ownership approval)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory incorporation fee for LLC under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 (base + approval surcharge)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO disclosure filing and AML compliance review fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: GAFI registered AML compliance filing office / EMLCU
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Service fee for the beneficial ownership form submission and sanctions/PEP screening administration

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office initial lease deposit for industrial/commercial address (recoverable – advance payment)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for industrial/commercial lease initial deposit in Egyptian industrial zones, 3 months' equivalent

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Industrial development license pre-application consultation (non-tax fee, optional but included in budget)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Industrial Development Authority (IDA) / Licensed technical office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Pre-incorporation administrative consultation for ISIC 2811 manufacturing approval

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Incorporation legal fees for drafting, coordination and due-diligence review (law firm)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered Corporate Law Firm in Egypt
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for multinational LLC incorporation with UBO filing and consular legalization management

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law No. 159 of 1981, as amended by Law No. 4 of 2009 (Articles 4-13 and 29-51 governing limited liability companies), read with Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and its Executive Regulations (GAFI one-stop incorporation); Law No. 67 of 2016 (Tax Procedures and VAT) and Labor Law No. 12 of 2003 for post-incorporation registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) — Companies Registration Department and One-Stop Shop (OSS), Cairo and governorate branches
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association (Mithaq Al-Ta'sis / AI-Mahdar) filed through the GAFI One-Stop Shop, culminating in the Certificate of Incorporation (Shahadat Al-Sharika)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: For an LLC under Law 159 of 1981: minimum issued capital of EGP 50,000, fully subscribed at formation; at least 25% of the capital must be paid in cash or in kind into a temporary corporate bank account prior to GAFI registration, and the balance must be paid within five years. No mandatory escrow beyond the temporary bank deposit certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION NO. 1 OF THE FIRST MEETING OF THE BOARD OF MANAGERS OF [COMPANY NAME] LLC, HELD AT THE REGISTERED OFFICE, CAIRO. RESOLVED: (1) The Memorandum and Articles of Association filed before GAFI are ratified. (2) The founders' subscription to the whole issued share capital is confirmed, and shares are allotted per the schedule of contributions. (3) The registered office located at [full address] is adopted as the company's legal seat. (4) [Manager A] is appointed Managing Director and [Manager B] Finance Officer, with authority to sign banking and government applications jointly. (5) Management is directed to obtain the industrial operating license, environmental approvals, and civil defense clearance, and to register for tax and social insurance. These resolutions are valid until revoked.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Reservation and Legal Form Pre-approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop (OSS) — Name Reservation Desk / online portal (gafi.gov.eg)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the online Name Reservation Application listing three descending preferred company names with the LLC designation. Pay the reservation fee electronically. GAFI screens the names against the Commercial Registry database and issues an official Name Reservation Certificate valid for 60 days.
required_dossiers: Copies of founders' national ID or passports
Power of Attorney (if an authorized representative acts for a founder)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If rejected due to similarity, immediately file a fresh application with modified names; alternatively, obtain a written rejection reason in writing and object before the GAFI Dispute Settlement Committee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, Signing, and Notarization of the Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (Shahr Al-'Aqari) with prior legal review clearance by GAFI's in-house reviewer
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed corporate attorney to draft the Memorandum of Association (MOA) and Articles of Association (AOA) compliant with Law 159 of 1981, covering managers, share capital, governance, and registered office. All founders must sign before a notary; the notary authenticates signatures and seals the submitted pages.
required_dossiers: Lease contract or title deed for the registered office
Acceptance letters for the initial managers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or GAFI reviewer returns the documents for deficiencies, amend the affected clauses, re-sign before the notary, and resubmit within 30 days without additional statutory fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit of Subscribed Capital in a Temporary Bank Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Egyptian commercial bank (e.g., National Bank of Egypt, Banque Misr)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary under-incorporation bank account in the company's name and deposit at least 25% of the minimum subscribed capital (EGP 12,500 of EGP 50,000). Obtain an official bank capital deposit certificate, which must be attached to the GAFI incorporation file.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank queries incomplete Know-Your-Customer data, supply corrected corporate documents or amend the authorized signatories; the applicant may designate a different bank and re-obtain the certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission and Registration with GAFI — Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the complete incorporation file through the GAFI OSS, pay the statutory registration fee (approximately USD 320 equivalent), and obtain the Certificate of Incorporation (Shahadat Qayd Al-Sharika) and the nine-digit Commercial Registry number. GAFI issues the certificate within statutory turnaround days.
required_dossiers: Lease contract for the registered office
Founders' national ID or passport copies
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI raises a query on discrepancies, remedy the flagged items within 15 days by filing corrected notarized pages; if the query is legal in substance, submit a memorandum of explanation or apply for amendment under Law 159 of 1981.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registry Endorsement and Official Gazette Publication
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Commercial Registry Desk acting with Al-Waqa'i Al-Misriya (Official Gazette)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: GAFI forwards the incorporation data to the Commercial Registry section of the OSS for automatic endorsement. Within 10 days, publish an abstract of the incorporation in the Official Gazette and obtain the final excerpt of the Commercial Registry record confirming legal existence.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the gazette publication is delayed, request expedited publication and correct any typographical errors through a supplementary gazette notice at the company's cost.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, VAT, and Social Insurance Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) — One-Stop Shop Desk; National Social Insurance Authority (NISA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the newly incorporated LLC with the Egyptian Tax Authority for corporate income tax, payroll withholding, and VAT at the standard rate of 14% under Law No. 67 of 2016 by submitting the tax card application. Simultaneously register as an employer with NISA under Law No. 148 of 2019 within 30 days of incorporation and obtain the employer social insurance certificate.
required_dossiers: Lease contract for the registered office
Board resolution appointing the tax representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If registration is submitted late, file a mitigation letter with the ETA dispute unit and the NISA compliance section to reduce or eliminate penalties, citing first-time incorporation and administrative delay.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Industrial Development Authority (IDA) in coordination with GAFI for investment projects
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Industrial Operating License (Rekhlas Al-Tashghil Al-Sina'i) for marine engine manufacturing plants under Industrial Licensing Law No. 15 of 2016

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA) — Ministry of Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B (medium impact) — requires submission of Environmental Impact Assessment scoping and screening; a full EIA Report is mandatory for engine manufacturing facilities above screening thresholds or located in environmentally sensitive zones, per Law No. 4 of 1994 and the EEAA EIA Guidelines for Manufacturing Industries.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Law No. 4 of 1994 (as amended by Law No. 9 of 2009) and Ministerial Decree No. 92 of 2011 for industrial wastewater to public sewer: pH 6-9, BOD5 <= 1,100 mg/L, COD <= 1,600 mg/L, TSS <= 800 mg/L, oil and grease <= 100 mg/L, phenol <= 0.02 mg/L, heavy metals <= 0.05-2 mg/L; stack particulate emissions and VOC workplace limits per the Executive Regulations and ambient standards of Decree No. 338 of 1995; hazardous waste manifest and disposal at licensed facilities per Ministerial Decree No. 111 of 2019.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Civil Defense Authority (Ministry of Interior) under Civil Defense Law No. 24 of 1962, covering extinguishers, fire pumps, hydrants, and evacuation plans; structural load verification certificate for the factory floor, mezzanines, and engine test cells from the competent municipality; occupational health and safety clearance from the Ministry of Manpower under Labor Law No. 12 of 2003, including workplace risk assessment, personal protective equipment, and first-aid provisions.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) - Official Portal: https://www.eta.gov.eg/
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign and local entities register with the Egyptian Tax Authority via the e-services portal or in-person at ETA branches. Required documents include commercial registration certificate, articles of association, ownership structure, board resolutions, and bank details. Approval yields a 13-digit Tax Registration Number (TRN) within 2-4 weeks, enabling VAT and corporate tax obligations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections available under Egyptian law. Corporate income tax applies at entity level per Income Tax Law. Hybrid mismatch rules, CFC provisions, and GAAR govern cross-border structures.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time e-invoicing through the ETA Fiscalization System with QR codes and digital stamps. All taxable supplies require API integration for central clearance and reporting. Non-compliance triggers immediate fines of EGP 5,000 per violation.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT rate applies to goods physically exported from Egypt and offshore services supplied to non-resident recipients outside Egypt. Eligibility requires proof of export and non-residency of the customer.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent or unsubstantiated zero-rating claims result in penalties of 100% of VAT due plus 2% monthly interest and potential criminal prosecution. Retrospective clawback applies if documentation is not provided within the three-year audit period.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE); the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) provides FDI registration coordination.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Egyptian Pound (EGP) is partially convertible. Current-account payments - trade-related, royalties, services, and profit remittances - may be processed through authorized banks after documentary review, tax clearance, and verification against CBE anti-money laundering rules. Capital-account inflows must be registered with the CBE under Law No. 194 of 2020; profit repatriation additionally requires an audited financial statement, a tax clearance certificate, and confirmation of no foreign-currency claims. Settlement timeliness can be affected by national FX liquidity, bank credit lines, and the CBE's priority list.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export receipts must be repatriated to Egypt through an authorized bank within 90 days after shipment date (with limited extension for counter-trade or staging). Under current CBE directives applying post-2024 float, mandatory conversion ratios have been substantially relaxed; however, a bank may still impose a reasonable conversion quota on EGP for operating needs. Exporters must file customs export declarations, commercial invoices, and the CBE's export proceeds tracking forms; un-repatriated proceeds are subject to statutory penalties and potential trade-license impact.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account + FDI Capital Account (CBE registration)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW (offshore EMIs) / MEDIUM (CBE-licensed onshore fintechs). Offshore digital EMIs cannot open Egyptian EGP settlement accounts, provide local clearing, or obtain CBE forex allocations; their use is limited to ancillary receivables collection outside Egypt and is subject to corporate bank consent. Onshore platforms holding a CBE Payment FinTech license may support API-driven collection and multi-currency pass-through, but hedging, LC issuance, and statutory foreign-currency accounts remain the exclusive domain of authorized banks. Thus, an industrial exporter should rely on licensed banks for core clearing; EMIs are only complementary.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is the general mandate. The General Manager and at least one shareholder/director must attend an in-person KYC interview at the Egyptian branch for UBO verification and specimen signature. In limited cases, an authorised representative with a notarized power of attorney (legalized at the Egyptian consulate) can be used for initial filing, but the bank typically requires a subsequent personal appearance or an approved video call before activating high-value debit privileges. Remote opening is not accepted by leading banks for export-oriented LLCs; the capital-escalation account likewise requires firsthand review.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO structure opacity or nominee-shareholder red flags.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified LLC foundation contract, commercial registry extract (Sijil), complete UBO declaration and ownership matrix, passports/Commercial Registration of all shareholders, board resolution appointing authorized signatories, and an internal AML compliance statement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-funds insufficiency for the capital escrow injection.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: 6-12 month bank statements per contributing shareholder, audited financial statements of the foreign parent, tax declarations of funds, source/export contracts for converted value, and a sworn statement of lawful origin (affidavit).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PEP or high-risk jurisdiction involvement or adverse media.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: World-Check or equivalent negative news/legal screening report, proof of economic substance (lease, staff, utility bills), trade license, import/export contracts, and a compliance letter from a locally designated AML officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Operational capacity mismatch with ISIC 2811 marine-engine manufacturing classification.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Plant lease/ownership title, machine import documents and insurance, capacity production plan, supplier contracts, customer LCs, and industrial registry extract (where applicable).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax non-compliance indicators or mismatch in tax card under CEMRA import controls.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid Egyptian Tax Card (Kart Al-Damayib), tax registration certificate, recent monthly VAT and withholding tax returns, tax clearance statement, and CBE/CEMRA registration screen showing the entity's authorized status.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital contributions must be transmitted by SWIFT MT103 from the investor's bank to the LLC's EGP/FCY account at the authorized Egyptian bank. The purpose/payment details field must state: 'FDI EQUITY - LAW 72/2017 - with GAFI ref. no.'; the bank will complete the CBE inward report (CI form) and an FDIDR acknowledgement within 30 days. Pre-transfer, the bank must receive a GAFI/stamped articles of association, an investment certificate, a resolution of the board, and IDs of all contributors. No cash transfers are permitted except through the banking channel; amounts above USD 100k require automatic enhanced due diligence and the statutory SAR/CTR thresholds (as per CBE instructions) apply.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For imported components, preferred rails are (i) irrevocable documentary letters of credit (UCP 600) issued by the LLC's Egyptian bank for large or LCL shipments, and (ii) SWIFT MT103/202 TT against documents for low-risk or open-account transactions. Before disbursement, the branch verifies customs declarations, supplier invoice genuineness, the entity's updated tax card and CEMRA registration, and may require overseas bank due diligence on the counterparty. Export foreign-currency receipts are settled via the bank and posted to CBE export monitoring. Outbound dividends or royalties require a CBE-compliant contract, tax withholding clearance, and audited statement.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: EGP/USD deliverable currency forwards backed by real trade or investment exposure
Cross-currency interest rate or principal swaps (USD/EGP) approved by the CBE for term liabilities
Regulated non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) via a licensed onshore bank, supported by valid underlying exposure
OTC currency options embedded in trade finance structures where permitted by the governing bank's risk policy

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Form for corporate taxpayers, attaching income statement, balance sheet, and supporting schedules)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) - Corporate Tax Department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months following the fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year entity the return must be filed by 30 April of the succeeding year. Extension available only through an authenticated application before the due date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file by the statutory deadline triggers an automatic penalty of 10% of the assessed tax, plus a monthly delay penalty of 2% of the unpaid tax, capped at 20% of the tax liability under Law No. 91 of 2005. Persistent non-filing leads to administrative desk assessment by ETA and, after enforcement warnings, suspension of the taxpayer's commercial certificate and initiation of strike-off proceedings by GAFI.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Audited Financial Statements with the Independent Auditor's Report, presented to the Annual General Assembly
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) (attachment to the CIT return); Egyptian General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) Company Registry (recorded to the entity's corporate file); shareholders' General Assembly (approval)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Financial statements must be audited and signed by the independent auditor within 6 months of the fiscal year-end; the Annual General Assembly must be convened by 30 June of the following year for calendar-year entities.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to prepare audited statements and to convene the General Assembly renders the managers and shareholders jointly liable for resulting losses under Articles 89-98 of Companies Law No. 159 of 1981. GAFI may impose an administrative non-compliance fine and, following a formal warning, petition the Economic Court for judicial dissolution of the LLC. Unaudited statements also cause the ETA to disregard the submitted tax return and apply an estimated assessment.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Commercial Registration Annual Renewal (renewal of the company's commercial record and activity licenses)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - Commercial Registry Office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the registration anniversary; GAFI's published compliance window generally requires renewal within January for all existing entities. For a newly formed LLC, the first renewal crystallizes on the first anniversary of the initial registration date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal accrues a daily administrative fine and suspends the commercial registration record. A suspended record removes the LLC's legal capacity to enter into enforceable contracts, extend bank facilities, or obtain customs release for imported marine engine components. Continued non-renewal for six months causes GAFI to publish a deletion/strike-off notice and permanently cancel the registration, triggering compulsory winding-up.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) Annual Re-attestation and Register Update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: GAFI - Electronic UBO Registry, jointly administered with the Egyptian Financial Intelligence and AML/CFT framework authorities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed contemporaneously with the annual commercial registration renewal; additionally, any direct or indirect shareholding shift of 10% or more must be reported within 30 calendar days of the notarized transfer instrument.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Incorrect, incomplete, or untimely UBO disclosure subjects the LLC to a civil fine of up to EGP 500,000 under Law No. 80 of 2002, as amended by Law No. 20 of 2023, with criminal liability where the misstatement masks unlawful fund flows. Banks and financial institutions must restrict the entity's accounts until the UBO register is rectified and verified.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No size-based exemption applies to an Egyptian LLC; Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 requires every limited liability company to appoint at least one independent certified auditor registered on the Egyptian Financial Regulatory Authority's approved list. The audit mandate operates irrespective of revenue, total assets, or headcount. A classified audit exemption is unavailable, and the ETA rejects corporate income tax returns that are not accompanied by a signed independent auditor's report.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS) issued by the Ministry of Investment and aligned with IFRS; IFRS as formally adopted in Egypt is permissible for export-oriented manufacturing groups and consolidated foreign parent reporting. The light diesel outboard engine manufacturing entity must also apply the capital allowance and depreciation rules contained in Law No. 91 of 2005 for all machinery and production equipment.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The statutory UBO register must identify every natural person holding or controlling, directly or indirectly, 10% or more of the LLC's equity, voting rights, or management control. At the annual Commercial Registry renewal, a manager must submit a sworn re-attestation, countersigned by the independent auditor, confirming that the beneficial ownership data on GAFI's electronic registry accurately reflects the preceding 12-month period. Any share transfer, including a back-to-back reallocation between non-resident related parties, must be recorded in the register and reported to GAFI within the 30-day statutory window.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 300 - USD 800 per annum (registered agent and licensed Cairo or Alexandria address, inclusive of notary and corporate document retrieval)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,800 - USD 3,500 per annum (independent certified audit fee for a light diesel outboard engine and compact generator manufacturing LLC with inventory and fixed assets)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Five-year corporate income tax exemption for manufacturing and export projects located in public/private free zones and the Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZone), subject to export quota conditions; investment incentives under Law No. 72/2017 may provide a tax allowance of up to 50% of invested capital, plus potential preferential rates for logistics and green-energy activities.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form No. 18 (Corporate Income Tax Return) filed electronically through the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) e-Portal at https://www.eta.gov.eg.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within four months following the end of the taxable year (e.g., a 31 December year-end return must be filed no later than 30 April).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identification: full legal name, address, commercial registration number, and tax card number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Applicant is an Egyptian LLC; use the entity's Egyptian tax ID. For a foreign branch, enter branch details and non-resident taxpayer identification with head-office address.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax period: fiscal year start and end dates for which the return is filed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Align with the statutory financial year adopted by the entity in Egypt; foreign branches must use a 12-month accounting period ending 31 December or another approved year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income statement: gross sales, export revenues, and any other business income subject to taxation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only Egypt-source income required; differentiate free-zone or SCZone export exemption income with supporting GAFI / SCZone approval.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Expenses: cost of goods sold, depreciation, salaries, financial charges, and administrative deductions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deduct only expenses proven to be actually incurred in Egypt and relevant to Egyptian-source income; intergroup charges require transfer-pricing documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income computation: adjusted net profit/loss, loss carryforward, and tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply 5-year loss carryforward (Egyptian-source losses only) and claim any treaty tax credits after withholding confirmation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 5% of the tax due for every two-month period of delay, capped at 50% of the tax due; late payment additionally incurs a 2% monthly surcharge on unpaid tax, together with default interest and enforcement measures.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% final withholding tax on dividends distributed by an Egyptian company to non-resident shareholders; resident corporate shareholders generally enjoy exemption on received Egyptian dividends.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke a reduced treaty rate, the non-resident beneficial owner must submit a Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) issued by its home-state tax authority to the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), together with a treaty-relief application and declaration of beneficial ownership, before the distribution or payment date; ETA then issues a reduced-withholding certificate (or the payer applies the treaty rate upon ETA confirmation). Excess amounts paid may be reclaimed by filing an amended return within the applicable limitation period.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic WHT: 20% on interest, royalties, and management/professional fees paid to non-residents. Treaty rates vary by double-tax agreement (typically 0%–15% for interest and 0%–20% for royalties) and require current TRC and beneficial-ownership evidence.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File: Mandatory where related-party transactions exceed EGP 10 million in aggregate; Master File: required when the multinational group's consolidated revenue equals or exceeds EGP 100 million; Country-by-Country Reporting applies for groups with consolidated revenue above EGP 25 billion.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Egypt has no formal Economic Substance Regulations styled after UAE/ESR, but the General Anti-Avoidance Rule (Article 102 of Law No. 91/2005) and ETA guidance require that intercompany arrangements reflect genuine commercial and economic substance; shell structures, circular transactions, and artificial allocation of risks or investments may be disregarded.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Fraudulent Tax Return
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Intentional omission of marine-engine export sales, fabrication of import/export invoices, destruction of accounting books, undeclared cash receipts from regional distributors, or submission of a knowingly false Form No. 18 return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine of EGP 20,000–200,000 and imprisonment of 2–5 years under Article 119 of Law No. 91/2005, in addition to recovery of the full avoided tax, 2% monthly late-payment surcharge, and up to 50% late-filing penalty.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, general managers, and signatories involved in or benefiting from evasion are jointly and severally liable for the company's unpaid tax; the corporate veil is pierced, with civil restitution, asset freezes, travel bans, and custodial sentences imposed.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Mis-pricing intercompany sales of assembled outboard engines to related entities, stripping Egyptian margin through excessive royalties or management fees, or violating thin-capitalisation debt-to-equity thresholds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ETA may re-assess taxable income at arm's-length amounts, deny excessive interest deductions, apply a 2% monthly surcharge on underpaid tax, and levy an additional non-disclosure penalty of up to 35% of the adjusted tax (Executive Regulations).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly approve pricing without robust transfer-pricing studies may be personally liable for the resulting tax shortfall; Egyptian courts can hold them as participants in concealment, with travel bans and seizure of personal assets being available.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Abuse of Legal Form (Economic Substance Failure)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating an Egyptian LLC with no physical office, employees, or operational control while booking all Egyptian revenue in the entity; using nominee directors without decision-making authority; or misrepresenting the place of effective management to avoid tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The General Anti-Avoidance Rule invalidates the transaction and re-characterises income to the true beneficial owner; the entity may be fined or subjected to compulsory liquidation and administrative sanctions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee directors and hidden beneficial owners are personally liable for taxes, fraud penalties, and criminal prosecution when the shell is used as a vehicle for evasion or unlawful distribution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Anti-Money Laundering / Terrorist Financing Red Flags
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving third-party payments for outboard engines from sanctioned or high-risk entities, executing irregular SWIFT or LC transactions mischaracterising end-use, or exporting disassembled engines with invoice mismatches to obscure ultimate destination.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Law No. 80/2002, fines up to EGP 1,000,000 and imprisonment of up to 7 years, plus mandatory asset freezing, confiscation of laundered funds, and revocation of export/import licences.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers, and beneficial owners face civil restitution, personal travel bans, disqualification from corporate board service, and imprisonment where they knowingly facilitate or fail to file suspicious-transaction reports with the Egyptian Anti-Money Laundering Unit.
